tasks.label: HELIOS: Workbench
tasks.detail: Prepare and open an isolated GUI editing branch; preserve existing edits.

tasks.label: HELIOS: Test part
tasks.detail: Run a part's fixed checks. GUI uses the shared native build on Windows.

tasks.label: HELIOS: GUI build
tasks.detail: Check GUI metadata and compile the existing WinUI project on Windows.

tasks.label: HELIOS: GUI preview (Windows)
tasks.detail: Build then open local sample states in the native Workbench; no service login.

tasks.label: build
tasks.detail: dotnet build HELIOS.sln -c Release (AIHub + CLI + MCP + tests; what CI runs)

tasks.label: stack-smoke
tasks.detail: pwsh scripts/verify/stack-smoke.ps1 (API + MCP handshake + CLI against the existing Release build)

tasks.label: first-run
tasks.detail: bash scripts/bootstrap/first-run.sh (one-command bring-up; prints the remaining owner checklist)

tasks.label: auth-doctor
tasks.detail: pwsh scripts/bootstrap/auth-doctor.ps1 (report-only auth diagnosis; nothing is mutated)
